text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"States a clear anti-driverless position from the opening sentence","quality":"clear claim","description":"It presents an explicit, arguable stance right away and keeps the reader oriented to the writer’s position."},{"evidence":"Gives separate examples about braking, steering, and hacking","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"It backs the claim with multiple concrete concerns rather than relying only on general opinion."},{"evidence":"Explains crash scenarios like being hit from behind or turning into traffic","quality":"logical development","description":"It develops the argument by showing how each feared malfunction could lead to a specific harmful outcome."},{"evidence":"Uses a closing warning about the price of death","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by restating the position and leaving the reader with a strong final judgment."},{"evidence":"Moves from introduction to examples to final warning","quality":"organization","description":"It has a more recognizable argumentative structure with a beginning, middle, and end."}]}
